findings: truth has a single dialect-marker prefix (`*國/蘇/廣…`) per line: the '3 columns' is a *dialect label* mapping, not a repeated per-row cell grid.
the page carries NO horizontal and NO vertical ruling; a table with 15 rows x 3 columns would normally show cell borders or at least consistent column gutters.
measured geometry is not a uniform 3-column page: region column counts = [3, 2, 1, 2].

the truth flattens reading order (left column block then right column block); the page actually places those blocks side by side, which is why plain OCR merges them onto one line — a reading-order mismatch, not necessarily an OCR miss.
